scope: Only HZ01/HZ02. Exact ch unit and quality-construction scope reviewed; modern-language gloss mapping alone is not identity evidence. Existing groups remain separate.

pairs.rationale: Both cards concern the same atomic unit ch in a quality-construction context and assert the normalized feucht/moist proposition. Their source status differs: GDT638 explicitly calls the older ch=feucht orientation overholt, while GDT622 records ch=moist as an atomic default. Therefore identity is limited to the historical proposed unit/value, not a current confirmed meaning or a merge of the current groups.

evidence.quote:
GDT622 hat die brauchbare historische Bauart bereits gefunden: gelerntes
Ganzwort plus kurzer, komponierter Fachcode. Es liefert aber nicht die heutige
Orientierung; sein damaliges `ch=feucht` ist überholt. GDT634 hat bereits
konkrete Stoff-, Qualitäts-, Träger- und Wertbausteine. Neu in GDT638 ist die
Aufnahme einer exakten Ganzoberfläche erst nach ihrem vollständigen
Vorkommensumlauf und der messbare zusätzliche Passagegewinn.

Thus the atomic defaults are `k=hot`, `t=cold`, `ch=moist`, and `sh=dry`.
`qo-` introduces the quality field. The final `y/ey` closes or connects the
bundle; it cannot be a particular degree because the same ending occurs on
source candidates with different degrees.

pairs.rationale: Both cards concern the same ch unit and normalized trocken/dry value in the quality construction. GDT631 makes trocken conditional on neighboring carrier scope, whereas GDT623 presents dry as a V2 default and reports a frequency advantage. They can be treated as the same historical proposition at the bounded ch quality-unit level, while retaining the conditional/default distinction and separate current groups.

evidence.quote:
Hier steht die trockene Kandidatenform unmittelbar vor dem feuchten `shol`;
f20v.3 wiederholt `shol chcthy`. Das kann zwei benachbarte technische Zellen
darstellen. Falls spätere Seiten zwingend zeigen, dass die Nachbarn denselben
Träger beschreiben, muss `ch=trocken` an dieser Stelle umgedeutet werden. Das
formale `ch/sh + CTH`-Paradigma bliebe trotzdem bestehen.

Thus `k=hot`, `t=cold`, `ch=dry`, and `sh=moist` are the V2 defaults inside the
quality construction. The moisture sign is the useful correction. The thermal
sign remains weaker: `t=hot, k=cold` is a serious rival on Herbal-only counts.

On the whole 179-page panel, V2 ranks first for exact, prefix, and substring
counts; the old GDT622 orientation ranks last. Herbal-only counts reverse the
thermal sign but retain `ch=dry`. Therefore the defensible update is stronger
